high_level_description: stc brand style, a woman stargazing with a telescope in a desert setting at night.

compositional_deconstruction.background: A nighttime desert scene with palm trees illuminated in warm orange and cool purple tones, two large glowing spherical lights, and a dreamy, cinematic atmosphere.

elements.desc: A young Middle Eastern woman wearing a light purple hijab and a long purple robe, seated on a red and purple patterned carpet.
A professional telescope on a silver tripod with a digital tablet mounted to it, positioned in front of her.
A small glass of tea resting on the carpet beside the telescope.
